$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM (sub2api single-enclave architecture). Fetched at runtime by the /proof page (see frontend/src/utils/attestation/reference.ts). Every change to this file is public git history — that is part of the trust story. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 via the attestor's event log on 2026-07-31 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report 4092bc20. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v13 indexes built from sourceCommit by publish-tee-images (run 30598354038); the keyless signatures were verified against certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/proof-solo, and the Fulcio certificates embed githubWorkflowSha = the sourceCommit below, so the digest-to-source binding is cryptographic rather than self-reported. This release adds the landing-page promo section and, with it, a media-src directive to the Content-Security-Policy: the promo video is hosted off-site, and without that directive <video> falls back to default-src 'self' and the browser blocks it. Note that this widens what the landing page may load from third parties; the /proof page itself loads no off-site media, and the measured-code guarantees are unaffected. Honest note on the publish window: as with proof-v12, composeHash could NOT be predicted ahead of the deploy — the app-compose.json wrapper returned by the API no longer reproduces the live hash under the CLI's serialization — so it was read back afterwards. Between the CVM update and this commit, /proof reported a mismatch against this file as a failed enclave. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged, so the enclave's E2EE public key, derived from the app key, is also unchanged.
